ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (revised and adopted by the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on November 8, 2024, effective January 1, 2025); Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information of Market Entities (State Administration for Market Regulation and People's Bank of China Order No. 3, effective November 1, 2024); Regulation of the People's Republic of China on the Administration of Market Entity Registration (State Council Decree No. 746); Measures for Customer Due Diligence and Customer Identity Data and Transaction Record Preservation by Financial Institutions (People's Bank of China Order No. 1, 2022).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Certificate of Registration of the foreign investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registrar or equivalent corporate registry in the foreign investor's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: If the origin state is an Apostille Convention member: obtain a notarial certificate from a local notary and then a Hague Apostille from the designated competent authority; the Chinese registry accepts that apostilled document directly. If the origin state is not a member: notarize the document, legalize it through the origin state Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and then legalize it by the Chinese Embassy or Consulate; no apostille is used. The two paths are mutually exclusive and must never be chained.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Active Status
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registrar or officer responsible for corporate status records in the foreign investor's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille Convention jurisdiction: notarize and apostille by the jurisdiction's designated competent authority. Non-member: notarize, obtain origin-state foreign ministry legalization, and then complete consular legalization by the Chinese Embassy or Consulate. Use one path only.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution authorizing the WFOE formation and Power of Attorney for the designated formation agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the foreign investor, notarized in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille Convention jurisdiction: sign before a notary public and then affix a Hague Apostille. Non-member: notarize, obtain origin-state foreign ministry legalization, and then obtain Chinese consular legalization. Apostille and consular legalization are alternative paths, not sequential.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Memorandum of Association / Constitutional Documents of the foreign investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign investor or registry issuing the charter documents, authenticated by the origin-state competent authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: For an Apostille state: notarized copy plus apostille by the state's competent authority. For a non-Apostille state: notarized copy, origin-state foreign ministry legalization, and then consular legalization at the Chinese Embassy or Consulate. There is no hybrid route.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter / Credit Reference Letter for the foreign investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial bank where the foreign investor maintains a corporate account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille state: signature confirmed by an authorized bank officer, then a notary public, then an apostille. Non-member state: banker confirmation, notary, origin-state foreign ministry, and then Chinese Embassy or Consulate legalization. Use exclusively the applicable path.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Every UBO, director, legal representative, senior manager, and authorized signatory must be screened at onboarding and continuously against the PRC Anti-Money Laundering Monitoring and Analysis Center (CAMLMAC) risk database, United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions list, Chinese Government sanctions lists, OFAC SDN List including the 50% ownership rule, and Interpol or national adverse media databases. PEPs comprising domestic and foreign prominent public officials, senior judges, military officers, and executives of state-owned enterprises require enhanced due diligence, source of funds and source of wealth verification, senior management approval, and enhanced transaction monitoring. Any sanctions or PEP risk hit must be escalated immediately; a Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) must be filed to CAMLMAC before incorporation. All screening evidence must be kept for ten years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) National Enterprise Name Self-Service Declaration and Reservation Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The legal name of the WFOE must be registered in simplified Chinese characters. Latin characters, pinyin, or foreign-language letters cannot constitute the legal name. The name must follow the four-tier structure: administrative division, trade name, industry or operating characteristics, and company form. For a wholly foreign-owned enterprise, the trade name may be a phonetic transliteration of the foreign investor's corporate name or an independent Chinese trade name. The English name, if any, is not part of the statutory registration and can be used only after the Chinese legal name is approved.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The reservation cannot be administratively extended; if the 30-day window lapses, the applicant must file a new name declaration. Upon name rejection, the foreign investor or formation agent must obtain the written rejection notice with the rejection code, review the cited reason, and within 60 days file an administrative reconsideration application with the municipal or provincial market regulation authority. The appeal must restate the proposed Chinese legal name, explain the four-tier structure, confirm the absence of prohibited tokens, and attach the foreign investor's certificate of incorporation, board resolution, and any ministerial or financial regulator pre-approval letter if a sensitive token is required. If the authority still rejects, the applicant may commence administrative litigation in the people's court within six months or immediately file a revised name declaration.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office, commercial mailbox, or shared desk-only address is not permissible for this high-risk licensed lending WFOE. The PRC Company Law and tax registration rules require a physical, fixed place of business in the registration district, evidenced by a lease or title deed, with actual staff, equipment, and document storage. Although some pilot free trade zones permit address listing for general companies, the financial regulator and PBOC mandate a physical operating center for a P2P or micro-lending platform. Banks will reject a virtual-office address during account opening, and SAMR may revoke the registration for inconsistency of business premises.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: 80% probability of at least one unannounced on-site inspection within the first 12 months due to the high AML/CFT risk tier. Inspection checklist: original lease agreement, landlord identity and property ownership certificate, company name plate matching the registered Chinese legal name, employment contracts and social insurance records, IT hardware and server room access logs, AML/CFT compliance manual, customer loan records, bank account opening documents, tax registration certificate, and local responsible person's proof of residence. Inspections may be triggered by a registered address mismatch, tax invoice anomalies, STR filings, or whistleblower reports.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified English-to-Chinese translation of foreign corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate per page for official certified translation plus legalization stamp service.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PRC legal counsel fees for pre-incorporation due diligence and AML/CFT compliance manual drafting
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for WFOE formation and high-risk fintech licensing advisory work.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: PRC law firm or registered formation agent

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision), Articles 3, 4, 5, 23, 26, 31, 32, 37, 46, 49, 58, 60 and 149; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2020), Articles 4, 6, 10, 28 and 31; Special Administrative Measures (Negative List) for Foreign Investment Access (current edition).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and the local Market Supervision and Administration Bureau of the province or municipality where the registered office is located.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Establishment Registration Application Form for a Wholly Foreign-Owned Limited Liability Company, filed with the local SAMR Office and accompanied by the approved Articles of Association.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum registered capital is required for the general WFOE incorporation, and the foreign investor may stipulate a capital contribution timetable in the Articles of Association. However, for the special internet micro-loan operating license, the local financial authority delegated by the National Financial Regulatory Administration generally requires a paid-up registered capital of not less than RMB 100 million, which must be deposited into a restricted capital verification account at a licensed bank and certified before the financial business license is issued.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION ADOPTED BY THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF THE COMPANY BY UNANIMOUS WRITTEN CONSENT IN LIEU OF A GENERAL MEETING. WHEREAS the Company has been promoted as a wholly foreign-owned enterprise limited liability company under the Company Law of the People's Republic of China, the Foreign Investment Law, and the applicable Foreign Investment Negative List; and WHEREAS the Board must establish the capital foundation, banking relationships, registered office, and statutory officer structure before the regulatory financial license is issued; NOW, BE IT RESOLVED THAT: 1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION. The issue and allotment of the registered capital as set forth in the Articles of Association are approved. Each director ratifies the capital contribution schedule, and the sole shareholder shall transfer the subscribed monies into the designated capital verification account. No share certificate shall be issued until full contribution is made and verified by the bank. 2. BANKING AUTHORIZATION. The Board approves the opening of a RMB basic deposit account and a foreign currency capital account at a licensed commercial bank in China. The legal representative, the general manager, and the chief financial officer are jointly authorized to execute account opening documents, sign banking mandates, direct payments, and receive regulatory clearance documentation, subject to dual signature authority and anti-money laundering requirements. 3. REGISTERED OFFICE ADOPTION. The Board adopts the registered office address stated in the establishment application, authorizes the execution of the lease, the recordation of the tenancy with SAMR, and the installation of the company signboard. Any relocation of the registered office shall be filed with SAMR before effectiveness. 4. STATUTORY OFFICER APPOINTMENTS. The Board appoints named individuals to the offices of legal representative, general manager, chief financial officer, compliance officer, and supervisor, each to serve until removal or resignation in accordance with the Articles of Association. The compliance officer is specially charged with obtaining and maintaining the internet micro-loan license, cybersecurity clearance, personal information protection compliance, and AML/CFT reporting obligations. 5. GENERAL AUTHORIZATION. The Board grants full power to the officers and outside counsel to execute, submit, amend, and supplement all incorporation filings, tax registrations, foreign exchange registrations, bank forms, license applications, and ancillary agreements necessary to commence lawful business. This resolution shall be effective immediately and shall remain binding upon all officers and the shareholder.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and Foreign Investment Negative List Eligibility Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SAMR National Enterprise Name Registration System through the local Market Supervision and Administration Bureau online portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed English company name and proposed Chinese business scope into the SAMR name reservation system using the local registration portal. Verify the current Foreign Investment Negative List to confirm that automated algorithmic underwriting for micro consumer loans is not a prohibited foreign investment sector and that a special financial license is available. Provide a written explanation of the intended online lending platform operations, the target payment rails, and the proposed paid-up capital schedule. Ensure that the legal representative, supervisors, and directors satisfy statutory eligibility requirements. Before submission, notarize and legalize the foreign investor incorporation documents and passport or corporate officer identification in the home jurisdiction.
required_dossiers: Notarized and legalized identity documents of the beneficial owner and directors
Proposed business scope and special license explanation
Power of attorney for the formation agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is queried or rejected for similarity or prohibited wording, file a revised name reservation within five business days using a different distinct name; if rejection is based on negative list ambiguity, request a written explanation from the local SAMR and submit a legal memorandum from PRC counsel, or seek administrative reconsideration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Incorporation Filing with the Market Supervision and Administration Bureau
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Supervision and Administration Bureau Establishment Registration Desk, under the State Administration for Market Regulation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the name reservation certificate is obtained, file the establishment application for the wholly foreign-owned enterprise with the local SAMR office using the approved name and the exact registered office address. Attach the signed Articles of Association, the first board resolution, the lease contract, the property ownership certificate, and the notarized or legalized identity documents of the shareholder and all proposed officers. The application must be signed and dated by the proposed legal representative, and every passport or corporate document must be verified against the original. The registry will examine the business scope wording, capital contribution provisions, and compliance of the financial service description with the negative list and local market access rules. Upon approval, SAMR issues the business license together with the unified social credit code and seal registration certificate.
required_dossiers: Original lease agreement and property ownership certificate
Notarized and legalized foreign investor documents
Passport copies of legal representative, directors, supervisor, and manager
Letter of appointment of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, SAMR will issue a deficiency notice and the applicant has up to ten business days to submit supplementary documents or a written explanation. If the application is rejected, the foreign investor may refile after correcting the deficient item, request reconsideration from the same bureau, or file an administrative reconsideration petition with the higher-level administration within the statutory time limit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Corporate Governance, Seal Engraving, Tax Registration, and Capital Account Formalization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau authorized seal engraving enterprise; State Taxation Administration; local Social Insurance Administration; local Housing Fund Center; State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) branch.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After issuance of the business license, engage a public security bureau approved seal engraving unit to produce the company seal, finance seal, legal representative seal, invoice seal, and contract seal. Complete tax registration through the e-tax system, obtain the taxpayer identification number, register with the social insurance and housing fund authorities, and file the company with the statistical department. Open a RMB basic deposit account and a foreign currency capital account at a licensed bank, then subscribe the paid-up capital into a restricted capital verification account and obtain a capital verification report. Register the foreign investor capital account with the local SAFE branch, file the actual controller information, and prepare statutory accounting books and board minutes. If the special financial license requires additional disclosure, update the bank compliance files with the final business structure.
required_dossiers: Business license with unified social credit code
Seal certificate from the public security bureau approved engraver
Board resolutions on accounts and authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or SAFE raises questions on capital verification or beneficial ownership, request a resubmission of the corrected forms within five business days and provide a supplemental legal opinion from PRC counsel. If the tax authority flags the business scope, correct the registration by filing a modification with SAMR and then resubmit the tax registration in the corrected scope.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Special Financial License Application for the Online Micro-Lending Platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Financial Regulatory Administration (NFRA) delegated to the local provincial or municipal Financial Regulatory Bureau; People's Bank of China AML reporting unit; Ministry of Industry and Information Technology for value-added telecommunication services.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Carry out the complete pre-licensing process with the local financial regulatory bureau for an internet micro-loan business license covering automated algorithm underwriting for micro consumer loans and ACH direct debit and local wallet payout rails. Submit the capital verification report, the board resolution authorizing the license application, the shareholder map, the AML/KYC policy, the data localization and personal information protection compliance statement, the algorithmic underwriting risk and fairness description, and the lending platform operational readiness plan. The application must describe debt collection rules, complaint handling procedures, business continuity, fraud prevention, and the high-risk special license controls imposed by the financial regulator. Upon preliminary acceptance, enter the formal license window and respond to all supervisory questions. If external model audit or security testing is required, commission a PRC licensed audit firm and submit the report within the cure period.
required_dossiers: Capital verification report from a licensed bank
Algorithmic underwriting risk and fairness report
Board resolution approving the regulatory license application
Shareholder and beneficial owner disclosure forms
Internal audit and compliance staffing plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the financial regulator queries or suspends the application, correct the specified deficiencies within ten business days and submit a supplementary filing. If denial is issued, the applicant may resubmit with a revised governance or capital structure, apply for a narrower licensed business scope, or challenge the decision through statutory administrative reconsideration before the corresponding government authority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: ICP Filing, Cybersecurity Classified Protection, and Office Fire Precinct Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) for ICP filing or operating license; local Public Security Bureau for Multi-Level Protection Scheme (MLPS 2.0) filing and assessment; local Fire Rescue Authority for fire safety acceptance certificate.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the ICP filing with MIIT or obtain the ICP operating license for the online financial platform as required for securities and financial information services. Carry out a cybersecurity classified protection filing and Level 3 security test under MLPS 2.0 through a PRC licensed evaluation agency. Submit the risk assessment report and platform security response manual to the public security bureau. For the registered office premises, obtain the fire safety acceptance certificate from the local fire rescue authority, complete the emergency evacuation plan, and perform the standard occupational safety and health registration for office employees. Because the company is a purely digital financial service provider and not a physical manufacturing, chemical, assembly, or warehousing operation, no environmental impact assessment is triggered; only general municipal waste disposal and e-waste handling rules apply. Once all approvals are issued, notify SAMR and the financial regulator of the licenses and commence pilot operations.
required_dossiers: ICP filing or operating license application
Fire safety self-inspection checklist and emergency plan
Final license copies for regulatory recordation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MIIT rejects the ICP application, cure the portal content deficiencies and resubmit within five business days. If the MLPS security test reveals deficiencies, remediate the vulnerabilities, retest, and submit the revised report. If the fire rescue authority does not approve the office certificate, implement the required fire protection rectification measures and schedule a re-inspection before continuing any platform operations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable for industrial licensing because this is a pure digital financial services platform; the relevant authorities are the National Financial Regulatory Administration (NFRA), the local Financial Regulatory Bureau, and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) for online platform and cybersecurity licensing.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Internet Micro-Loan Business License and Online Value-Added Telecommunications Service (ICP) Operating License for the Automated Underwriting Platform.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China through the local Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not Applicable - Environmental Registration is not required because the business is a digital financial platform with no physical manufacturing, chemical, assembly, warehousing, or industrial discharge activity.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable - zero industrial wastewater, VOC emissions, or hazardous waste generation. General office solid waste is collected by the municipal system, and electronic waste is handled under the general regulations on the administrative control of electronic waste; no quantitative industrial discharge thresholds apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil defense industrial fire permits and structural load inspections are Not Applicable because the company operates only an office-based digital lending platform. A standard fire safety acceptance certificate for the office premises under the Fire Protection Law is mandatory, together with the completion of an emergency evacuation plan, fire extinguisher placement, and workplace occupational safety registration for office employees. The platform is prohibited from commencement of operations until those occupational and safety clearances are recorded and available for regulatory inspection.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA); electronic tax filing portal: STA Electronic Tax Bureau available through chinatax.gov.cn, with all VAT, corporate income tax, and stamp duty filings performed online.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE), the foreign-invested entity first registers with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and obtains the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), an 18-character identifier that functions as the PRC taxpayer identification number. The SAMR registration information is automatically exchanged with the tax administration; the entity must then complete or confirm its tax registration with the local competent STA bureau, normally through the e-Tax Bureau, within 30 days of license issuance. The WFOE must file its articles of association, registered address proof, legal representative identity documentation, banking account confirmation, and expected business scope in the tax registration. The competent tax authority determines the relevant taxes and levies, including corporate income tax, VAT, stamp duty, urban maintenance and construction tax, and education surcharges, and it then formalizes the taxpayer account under the USCC. If the expected annual taxable turnover exceeds CNY 5,000,000, the WFOE must apply for general VAT taxpayer status; a non-resident enterprise without a permanent establishment in China does not obtain a Chinese USCC and instead registers as a non-resident taxpayer through its withholding agent so that China-source income taxes can be withheld at the statutory rates.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None under PRC tax law; China does not provide check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch entity classification elections for domestic registered enterprises. A WFOE may voluntarily register as a general VAT taxpayer before the turnover threshold is met, but this is an invoice-treatment election rather than an entity tax classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: All business entities with taxable supplies must complete tax registration; mandatory general VAT taxpayer registration is triggered when annual taxable turnover exceeds CNY 5,000,000 (RMB 5 million) over any continuous 12-month period. Entities below the threshold may elect general taxpayer status if their accounting is sound; small-scale taxpayer treatment applies below the threshold, with a reduced VAT levy rate for eligible small-scale suppliers.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: VAT invoices must be issued through the State Taxation Administration's Unified Electronic Invoice Service Platform; all fully digitalized electronic invoices must be created by the taxpayer through the e-Tax Bureau platform and are transmitted to the STA tax system in near real time with a tax-control code and anti-counterfeit electronic stamp. The STA Golden Tax Phase IV system automatically reconciles invoice issuance, VAT returns, payment, and input credit claims using application programming interface (API) data exchange for large taxpayers. No VAT special invoice may be issued without an STA-issued tax-control registration and digital fiscal stamp; failure to route invoices through the authorized electronic invoice system renders input VAT deductions unavailable.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: For goods, 0% VAT export treatment applies if the exporter is a registered VAT general taxpayer, the goods are actually declared for export and leave China customs territory, the export contract is genuine, and the corresponding foreign currency proceeds are repatriated into China within the statutory period. For services, cross-border taxable services are zero-rated or exempt only when they fall within the specific services listed in the Ministry of Finance and STA cross-border taxable services zero-rating and VAT exemption catalogue and when the services are consumed entirely outside China by a non-resident recipient with no domestic consumer nexus; a P2P micro-lending platform must therefore obtain confirmatory tax-treatment advice before applying zero rating to offshore loan facilitation fees, because financial services are not broadly zero-rated. Qualifying exporters must retain all evidence supporting actual export, foreign consumption, payment from outside China, and the proper invoice chain.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration for goods (Export Goods Customs Declaration in the export tax-refund channel)
Bill of Lading, air waybill, or combined transport document evidencing physical departure from China customs territory
Commercial invoice, packing list, and export sales contract
Bank foreign-exchange income declaration or inward remittance voucher evidencing receipt of export proceeds from the foreign buyer
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If the export zero-rating claim is not fully substantiated, the STA will claw back the refunded output VAT, assess output VAT and input VAT credit adjustments, impose a late-payment surcharge of 0.05% per day on the underpaid tax, and, in fraud or evasion cases, levy an administrative penalty of 50% to 5 times the evaded tax. Wholly fictitious export declarations, forged customs documents, or false remittance vouchers may be referred to judicial authorities for criminal liability under the PRC Criminal Law for fraudulent export tax refunds; the entity may also be named in the STA major tax violation publicity list and disqualified from export tax refund and zero-rating privileges.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), the exchange-control arm of the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The People's Republic of China operates an administratively supervised managed float with a two-track convertibility framework. Current-account receipts and payments are generally convertible and settlement and sale of trade- and service-related foreign exchange is deregulated, but capital-account transactions such as direct investment injections, foreign debt, cross-border security and repatriation of equity capital require pre-registration or approval with SAFE and the transactional bank. For a wholly foreign-owned enterprise (WFOE), share capital and shareholder loans brought in from overseas must pass through a foreign exchange capital account after an FDI foreign exchange registration; funds are credited subject to real-use supervision and the SAFE positive-list approach. Profit remittances are permitted after affirmative tax clearance, statutory auditing by a PRC CPA, and declaration through the bank under a current-account distributed-profit item; in practice, the treasury must demonstrate that the underlying earnings derive from a licensed micro-lending operation and that all withholding taxes on interest and income have been fully settled. Settlement of RMB into operational cash or lending disbursements is allowed for working capital, rent, payroll, software licensing and approved digital lending infrastructure, but cannot be diverted to securities investment, wealth management, real estate or unrelated transactions. The RMB exchange rate remains a controlled floating rate set against a basket; derivative hedges are permitted only with genuine exposure. Therefore, the WFOE must design a fully documented daily liquidity plan that separates foreign-currency capital, RMB consumer-loan disbursement accounts, and tax and escrow accounts to satisfy SAFE spot checks and bank compliance reviews.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Statutory framework: export foreign-currency proceeds must be repatriated to a domestic bank account within 180 days from the date of export customs declaration, unless a longer credit term is approved and declared via the Trade Monitoring System; the mandatory conversion or surrender ratio is 0%. The exporter may maintain 100% of collected proceeds in a foreign-currency settlement account or voluntarily convert to RMB at the market rate. All receipts, regardless of amount, must be declared to the receiving bank through SAFE's cross-border receipt and verification platform and matched against the electronic customs declaration form. In practice, service-trade and high-tech export proceeds forming the treasury inflow for the WFOE must be supported by invoices, service contracts and an internal certificate of compliance for SAFE's trade verification system.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Foreign Currency Capital Account and RMB Basic Operational Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Capital Settlement Account and RMB Basic Deposit Account
Foreign Exchange Capital Account and Licensed Lending Disbursement Custody Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Cross-border fintech EMI players such as Airwallex, Currenxie and Payoneer are not licensed as domestic commercial banks in China and cannot lawfully open primary corporate accounts for PRC-incorporated WFOEs under the PBOC banking account rules. Their ancillary acceptance can only be used for inbound e-commerce collection in foreign currency and is not suitable as the regulated lending cash-flow spine. A high-risk micro-loan platform's bank account, loan disbursement custody account and consumer repayment collection mandates must be held at a SAFE-designated onshore bank because SAFE transaction-verification, AML customer due diligence and capital-account supervision require a licensed PRC banking counterparty. Any attempt to use EMI omnibus rails for equity capital settlement, consumer lending payouts, or profit remittance would trigger regulatory violation and immediate account freezing; therefore, the legal viability of EMI onboarding is Low and the recommended route is a domestic tier-one commercial bank account opened directly by the WFOE.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The statutory legal representative and at least one director or authorized beneficial owner of the WFOE must normally appear physically at the bank branch for identity verification and the KYC interview. Since the entity is classified as high-risk due to micro-lending and algorithmic underwriting, the issuing bank will require the corporate seal, power of attorney, original board resolution and the physical passports of all key controllers. Remote consular proxy opening is not permitted for first-time capital-account accounts in the current environment. Where an overseas director is based outside China, the legal representative may instruct a senior local finance manager to attend in person, but the legal representative must additionally provide a notarized and Chinese-embassy legalized power of attorney, together with a bank-grade video interview under dual-party control; practical mandates still prefer physical attendance of the legal representative for the onboarding of a foreign-parent microlending platform.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore intermediate shareholding chain (Cayman/BVI/HK) hides the ultimate beneficial owner and exposes the account to sanctions and PEP contamination.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide certificate of incorporation, register of directors, register of shareholders, memorandum and articles of association for each offshore entity in the ownership chain; a comprehensive group chart showing percentages, control rights and economic ownership; notarized and legally certified declarations of UBO with passport and address proof; sanctions and PEP screening reports from a recognized international data provider for all UBOs and directors; and audited financial statements or bank statements tracing the source of wealth for each material shareholder.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The micro-lending business scope may be mistaken for an unauthorized P2P intermediary, triggering consumer protection and regulatory tier straining.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Supply the financial or small-loan operating permit issued by the local financial regulatory bureau or the National Financial Regulatory Administration; commercial business license containing the exact licensed internet micro-loan or consumer finance scope; regulatory filings proving the platform is a licensed lender, not an information intermediary; a legal opinion or letter of no enforcement action from the local financial office; standard consumer credit agreements and compliance policies covering interest ceilings, APR disclosure, data privacy, dispute handling and debt collection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound equity capital sourced through Hong Kong or NRA accounts, trusts or intercompany set-offs lacks a transparent foreign-remittance provenance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Furnish board resolution and shareholders resolution for the capital contribution; SAFE FDI foreign exchange registration record or the bank's foreign exchange registration form; complete remittance history from the shareholder account to the WFOE account including SWIFT MT103s; underlying source-of-funds documents such as dividends, equity-sale agreements, transferred proceeds or trust settlement deeds; negative-list compliance filing from MOFCOM or AMR; and a CPA capital verification report confirming that funds entered China through the registered capital route before any use.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume, algorithm-driven consumer loan disbursements and repayment routes through local wallets create layered transaction patterns that exceed ordinary bank monitoring expectations.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver the lending platform's system architecture showing automated transaction monitoring, amount thresholds, velocity rules, duplicate disbursement detection, negative-news screening and suspicious transaction report workflow; borrower-level KYC and AML control framework; production statistics for disbursement volume, loan sizes and repayment sources; independent information-security and AML audit report; and a written undertaking that all borrower funds, cash collateral and repayments will flow exclusively through the bank's treasury account with real-time API access to the bank.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound equity contributions must be pre-registered through the FDI foreign exchange registration system at the receiving bank, with shareholder and WFOE details recorded in SAFE's database. The remitting bank must transmit a SWIFT MT103 using the purpose code classified by SAFE as direct investment or equity capital contribution, explicitly identifying the WFOE and the foreign investor. RMB-denominated capital injections should use CIPS with the instruction RMB FDI Equity Contribution and reference the foreign investment registration certificate. Immediately after receipt, funds stay in the foreign-currency capital account or RMB capital account; the bank will not permit unauthorized disbursement before the PRC-certified CPA completes a capital verification report and the bank has verified the foreign exchange registration. Once verified, funds can be settled into RMB for payroll, office lease, IT infrastructure, cloud services and consumer-lending loan disbursement, each payment requiring a purpose-linked invoice or receipt and SAFE-compliant real-use evidence. Repatriation of surplus capital or dividends requires prior SAFE or retail bank filing, tax settlement and audited financial statements; the wire must be processed through the same bank using a current-account or distributed-profit purpose code with proof of the foreign investor's bank account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For pure service-trade disbursements such as software licensing, IT hosting, data services and consultancy, use SWIFT MT103 with the service-trade payment purpose code and matching contract, invoice, withholding tax certificate and bank-transaction verification. For physical imports necessary to operate the lending technology, a commercial letter of credit (L/C at sight) or documentary collection (D/P or D/A) may be issued through the same onshore bank, but the WFOE's core loan-outbound flows must never travel through an L/C because lending is not a merchandise trade. Outbound disbursements for licensed micro-loan originations remain domestic RMB rails via bank transfer or the licensed borrower wallet, not SWIFT. All cross-border outbound payments must be reconciled in the SAFE trade-monitoring platform; any transfer made before documentation is available will be treated as non-compliant and automatically blocked.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable RMB/FX forward contracts in the interbank or bank-customer market with a genuine current-account or capital-account exposure and 100% underlying documentation
Cross-currency swaps for matched principal and interest on approved foreign-debt or shareholder-loan balances only after the debt has been registered with SAFE and within the foreign-debt quota
Bank-intermediated FX options including collars where notional exposure is asymmetric but strictly limited to the audited forecast transaction flow

Offshore non-deliverable forwards and any speculative NDF overlay are not permissible for a PRC domestic entity; if a hedge is needed, it must be settled deliverably onshore with banks holding a valid derivative license

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Enterprise Annual Information Publicity Report (Enterprise Annual Report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 January to 30 June immediately following the 31 December fiscal year-end; newly incorporated entities first file in the year after registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: If unfiled, SAMR lists the entity as an enterprise with abnormal operations within 10 working days after 30 June; failure to rectify within three consecutive years triggers placement on the Serious Illegal and Dishonest Enterprise List, joint disciplinary restrictions on the legal representative and directors, and may ultimately support administrative cancellation/strike-off of the registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Final Settlement and Filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) through the competent local tax bureau
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 May following each 31 December tax year (within five months after the end of the tax year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment accrues a daily surcharge of 0.05% of the overdue tax; failure to file on time is subject to an administrative fine up to RMB 2,000, increased to RMB 2,000-10,000 for serious cases; false or fraudulent annual returns may attract a penalty of 50% to 500% of the unpaid tax, compulsory collection measures, and revocation of regulatory approvals.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Investment Information Annual Report (FIE Annual Report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) and SAMR through the integrated national annual-report system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 January to 30 June following the fiscal year end; foreign-invested enterprises must report prior-year foreign-investor information within that window
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to report leads to a written rectification order and inclusion in abnormal-operation/credit-discipline records; refusal to rectify or false/concealed foreign-investment information may result in a RMB 100,000 to RMB 500,000 fine under the Foreign Investment Information Reporting Measures and can trigger wider regulatory audit or cancellation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory Annual Financial Statement Audit by a PRC CPA Firm
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company shareholders' meeting and board of directors; audited financial statements are retained at the registered office and made available to the STA in support of the tax filing and to SAMR/MOFCOM during annual-report verification
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must be completed before the WFOE annual shareholders' meeting and no later than practical alignment with the 31 May annual CIT deadline; the annual shareholders' meeting of a limited liability company must be held within six months after fiscal year-end (by 30 June)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Un-audited financial statements cannot be lawfully approved by shareholders; the annual tax return may be treated as incomplete, exposing the entity to tax penalties; failure to comply with PRC Company Law and Accounting Law audit requirements is a regulatory offence that may lead to warnings, fines, and in persistent cases administrative cancellation of registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Supervisory Return and Special-Purpose Regulatory Audit for Licensed Micro-Lending / Internet Consumer-Lending Platform (if license is held)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Financial Affairs Supervision Bureau and National Financial Regulatory Administration (NFRA), with anti-money-laundering reporting to the People's Bank of China (PBOC) where applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: As set by the financial license, ordinarily within four months after fiscal year-end (by 30 April) or such earlier date required by the local regulator
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Supervisory admonition, mandatory rectification, temporary suspension of new loan origination, enhanced AML inspection, higher risk rating, administrative fines by PBOC/NFRA, and, for chronic or serious violations, suspension or revocation of the special financial license.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: There is no balance-sheet, turnover, revenue, or headcount exemption for PRC limited liability companies. A WFOE must obtain an independent audit of its annual financial statements in every fiscal year under the PRC Company Law and Accounting Law. In addition, the licensed micro-lending/consumer-finance platform is a high-risk financial activity and must also undergo annual regulatory, internal-control, AML/IT special-purpose audits required by NFRA/PBOC, irrespective of entity size.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CAS/ASBE), which are IFRS-converged; audit engagements are performed under PRC Standards on Auditing (CSA). Because the entity is a licensed-style financial micro-lending business, the simplified Accounting Standards for Small Enterprises does not apply; full CAS is required for annual financial statements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: China does not maintain a standalone annual UBO return for a WFOE. The annual foreign-investment information report and annual enterprise credit-information report must disclose equity-chain and ultimate controller information accurately. Any transfer of WFOE equity is effective against the company on the date it is recorded in the Register of Members, and the company must apply to SAMR for alteration registration within 30 days after the shareholding change; the same 30-day rule applies to changes in directors, supervisors, registered capital, articles of association, and addresses. False, incomplete, or untimely UBO/equity disclosures expose the entity to abnormal-operation listing, credit discipline, and penalties under the Foreign Investment Information Reporting Measures and Company Law.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Charges and Mortgages (security/encumbered assets and share pledges)
Statutory Minute Book recording shareholders' meetings, board meetings and supervisory board meetings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,000 - USD 3,500 per year for registered-address administration, professional corporate secretarial/agent services, and statutory register maintenance in major Chinese commercial cities.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,000 - USD 15,000 for a typical asset-light WFOE; USD 20,000 - USD 45,000 or more when the licensed micro-lending platform requires NFRA/PBOC special-purpose audit, AML/internal-control testing, and license-condition reviews.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Small Low-Profit Enterprise (SLPE) concession: effective 5% for taxable income up to RMB 3 million plus 300 employees and RMB 500 million assets; High-Tech New Enterprise (HTNE) concession at 15%; R&D expenses entitled to 100% super deduction; financial institutions' loan loss provisions deductible under approved scales; no statutory free-zone income tax holiday for financial services; fintech lending platform does not automatically qualify for industrial preferences.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form A100000 (Annual Enterprise Income Tax Return) and mandatory supporting schedules (A101010, A105000, A105050, A107012), filed electronically via the State Taxation Administration's e-Tax filing portal (自然人或电子税务局/Electronic Tax Bureau)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (with quarterly provisional tax prepayments filed within 15 days after the end of each quarter)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual return must be filed and final tax settled within 5 calendar months after the fiscal year-end (i.e., by May 31 of the following year); quarterly installments due on April 15, July 15, October 15 and January 15 using the A200000 provisional return

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross turnover from core business, including interest revenue from automated micro-loans, platform origination fees, account servicing fees, and algorithmic underwriting service income net of consumption tax/Surcharges only where permitted.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For the Chinese WFOE, include all income accrued from Chinese borrowers and overseas PSP partners. If income is derived from financial services performed partly outside China through a foreign branch (if any), apply source rules under Article 7 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law (EITL); adjust revenue to exclude income already assessed on a gross-basis for non-resident branch enterprises. No foreign tax credit is entered on this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs relating to the lending platform operation: personnel salaries, underwriting algorithm cloud-service costs, credit-rating data procurement, loan origination fees to channel partners, and loan-loss provisions actually reserved.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deduct only costs supported by compliant invoicing. Payments for foreign cloud, data or algorithm services are deductible subject to the preparation of contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation. If the foreign service provider physically performs R&D outside China, a withholding tax at 10% plus VAT (6% / 3% depending) must be levied at payment; failure to withhold causes the WFOE to become jointly liable for the under-withheld amount.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: General management overheads: executive salaries, legal fees, treasury back-office costs and domestic travel; not including expenses capitalized as intangible assets.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Management fees paid by the WFOE to its overseas parent (headquarters services) are NOT deductible unless a specific arm's-length fee-for-service agreement with evidence of substantive service performance and actual benefit is available. Payments characterized as royalty or bundled profit contributions must be segregated; a mischaracterization risks full disallowance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Interest expense on intercompany and third-party borrowings, bank charges, foreign exchange losses, and guarantee fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest paid to foreign parent or affiliate is deductible only up to the thin-capitalization ratio: debt-equity ratio limit 2:1 for financial institutions and 2:1 for other enterprises (including lending platforms). The excess interest expense is non-deductible and treated as a deemed dividend for withholding tax purposes. DTA relief on interest may reduce WHT from 10% to 5%—10% depending on treaty, but the deduction limit is a domestic-law restriction unaffected by the treaty.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Impairment allowance on prepared loans, trade receivables, and loan-loss provisions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Under EITL Implementation Regulations, impairment losses are generally not deductible unless specifically approved (e.g., for financial institutions under the Ministry of Finance's provisioning rule). For a P2P micro-lending platform, only actual loan charge-offs verified as uncollectible are deductible; provision reversals must be recognized. Non-resident ownership is irrelevant to this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Dividend and interest income on short-term wealth-management products, bonds, and shareholding returns.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Dividends received by the WFOE from a Chinese resident subsidiary are tax-exempt; dividends from non-resident subsidiaries are fully taxable with an indirect foreign tax credit claimable. Since the WFOE is a holding/trading hybrid, gross-up calculations for deemed credits must be attached in Schedule A107014.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: After adding and deducting permanent adjustments and tax-loss carryforwards, this line shows the net taxable income or loss.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any negative amount may be carried forward only 5 years. Interest under intercompany financing that exceeds the arm's-length rate must be added back here. State all transfer pricing adjustments on Schedule A105000. If the WFOE is deemed to be a conduit under China's general anti-avoidance rule (GAAR), the tax authority may re-characterize all profit; see red flags.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applying reduced rate 25% → 15% (HTNE) or 20% → 5% effective for SLPE.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE may elect the SLPE concession only if it has fewer than 300 employees, annual taxable income under RMB 3 million, and total assets under RMB 500 million. For fintech platforms with more than 100 employees, verify headcount aggregation across related domestic entities. Non-resident shareholder status does not preclude the concession.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax payments withheld on behalf of non-resident beneficiaries: dividends distributed to foreign parent, interest paid to foreign lenders, royalties for foreign software/data, and service fees paid to non-resident service providers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance_additional: Complete Schedule A105030 for cross-border payments, and use the special WHT return Form F700 to remit the tax within 7 days of the payment date. If the payment is a dividend, the withholding rate is 10% unless a treaty applicable to the parent (e.g., China–Hong Kong treaty reduces to 5% if the parent holds 25% or more directly). Attach the Beneficial Ownership Certificate and Tax Residency Certificate before distributing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net remaining tax after quarterly prepayments and foreign tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile any overpaid withholding on non-resident dividends with the lower treaty rate; apply for refund (not credit) from the tax bureau with Form F301. Ensure the underlying economic substance in the WFOE is present to avoid treaty denial on the dividend.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: RMB 2,000 per occurrence (up to RMB 10,000 for aggravated cases) plus daily interest (0.05% per day) on unpaid tax. Omission due to false data / falsified intercompany contracts: 50%-500% of the under-declared tax, plus a daily 0.05% late-payment surcharge. If underpaid tax exceeds RMB 50,000 in one year or exceeds 10% of the total tax payable for the year, criminal liability for tax evasion (Article 203 of the Criminal Law) may trigger, with fines from RMB 50,000 to 500,000 and imprisonment of up to 7 years for directors.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% (w.e.f. 1 January 2008 under Article 3 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law; collection at source on dividends derived from Chinese-source profit paid to non-resident shareholders)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To obtain a reduced DTA withholding rate (e.g., 5% for a qualified 25%-or-more direct shareholder under the China–Hong Kong DTA, or 10% under many other treaties), the non-resident shareholder must (i) submit a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the home jurisdiction endorsed by the tax authority, (ii) provide a declaration of beneficial ownership (Form 10) identifying the ultimate individual or listed ultimate parent in the ownership chain, (iii) substantiate that the foreign entity meets substance requirements (no shell or conduit: staff, office, active business), and (iv) complete and submit the Non-resident Taxpayer Treaty Entitlement Form (State Taxation Administration Announcement No. 35 of 2019) to the withholding agent (WFOE) before the dividend distribution. The WFOE retains the documentation, and the tax bureau can require prior approval if the payment exceeds RMB 50 million. Refund procedures under Articles 56-57 of the Measures for Non-resident Taxpayers to Claim Treaty Treatment apply if the tax was initially withheld at the statutory rate.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest: statutory withholding 10%; treaty rates typically 5%–10% (e.g., 10% under China–Germany, 7% under China–UK preferred creditor rule; 5% under China–Singapore for banks). Royalties for software and data algorithms: statutory 10%; treaty reductions often to 5%–10% (e.g., 5% under China–Japan and China–France; 10% under China–USA if no special provision). The WFOE paying must withhold within 7 days and file STR (Statement for Withholding Income Tax).

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File threshold: intercompany tangible property transfers in the prior year exceeding RMB 200 million; intangible property transfers exceeding RMB 100 million; financial transfers (loans, guarantees) exceeding RMB 100 million; services exceeding RMB 40 million; other transactions exceeding RMB 20 million. Master File is mandatory if total related-party revenue (turnover) in the prior year exceeds RMB 1 billion. These thresholds are per State Taxation Administration Announcement No. 42 of 2016.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China applies a substance-over-form doctrine under Article 47 of EITL and the General Anti-Avoidance Rule (GAAR) under Article 120 of the Implementation Regulations. Tax authorities may assess whether the WFOE's personnel, offices, server logistics and decision-making functions in China constitute core income-generating activities (CIGA) applying the OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines. If the platform merely passes risks to an offshore parent without real control, or if contractual allocation of profits is inconsistent with actual contributions, the tax bureau may re-characterize the transaction, adjust the taxable profit, and levy a 5% interest rate marker on the assessed deficiency. Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) as known in offshore centres do not formally apply in China, but CIGA analysis in the 2024 Special Tax Adjustment Work Guidelines effectively enforces the same principle.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion Through Artificial Revenue Suppression
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Systematically recording a portion of interest and late-fee income from micro-loans as untaxed 'platform service fee rebates' to an offshore collection agency, or issuing false invoices to Chinese borrowers to reduce reported gross income, while funneling true economic benefit to the non-resident shareholder.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Article 63 of the Law on the Administration of Tax Collection: the tax authority will recover the underpaid tax and impose a fine of 50% to 500% of the evaded tax amount. If the evaded tax exceeds RMB 50,000 and exceeds 10% of the amount legally payable, Article 203 of the Criminal Law may result in a fine and imprisonment for up to 7 years for the responsible directors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Under Article 20 of the Company Law and Article 14 of the Tax Collection Administration Law, directors who knowingly approved the false accounting face joint and several civil liability to restore all evaded taxes plus interest, and may be subjected to border exit controls (blacklisting) and 15–365 days of administrative detention, with criminal imprisonment of 3–7 years for fraud involving public funds or aggravated circumstances.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed Deposit Taking / Public Lending without Financial License
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a P2P micro-lending platform that solicits funds from unrelated internet investors under a 'lending-return' model without a valid financial license from the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission (CBIRC); using algorithm-assisted target matching to pool retail money and disburse loans, effectively engaging in absorbing public deposits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Article 176 of the Criminal Law (Illegal Absorption of Public Deposits) imposes fines of RMB 20,000–200,000 for the entity and imprisonment of 3–10 years for the 'directly responsible managers'. Under the Measures for the Administration of Internet Lending Information Intermediary Institutions (2016), unlicensed platforms are shut down and their bank accounts frozed.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Corporate veil-piercing is specifically applied: directors, legal representatives and actual controllers are jointly and severally liable to return each investor's principal and interest if they have used investor funds for personal expenditures or to disguise the P2P loan book. Courts order travel bans (City Exit Notices) and Chinese personal ID restriction measures; criminal detention cannot be bailed if the raised funds exceed RMB 1 million.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Mispricing of the Core Lending Algorithm
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE pays an onerous royalty or 'data license fee' to the beneficial owner-controlled offshore IP holding company for the robo-underwriting algorithm, while the WFOE's employees actually run the scoring, negotiate with local wallet providers, and carry the platform default risk; the payment is set at a 40% gross margin rate, far above the OECD 10%–20% median for routine fintech services.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Special Tax Adjustment under Article 41 EITL and Article 121 Implementation Regulation: the tax authority re-determines the arm's length price, adds back the excess royalty, imposes a 5% interest surcharge on the underpaid tax, and assesses a 50%–200% penalty for false pricing. Under Article 44 of the EITL, failure to file contemporaneous TP documentation triggers an additional penalty of RMB 100,000 to 1,000,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The director who chairs the transfer pricing committee cannot disclaim liability by signing a separate 'service agreement'; under the Company Law's duty of care, if the inflated royalty caused the WFOE to violate its minimum registered capital obligations and default on creditors, the director must compensate the WFOE's loss from personal assets. The State Taxation Administration may blacklist the director's name under the 'Joint Punishment for Major Tax Overdue' system, restricting high-consumption travel, airline use and property purchase, and in the worst case initiate criminal proceedings for fraudulent avoidance under Article 201 Criminal Law (imprisonment up to 3 years for gross underpayment).
